text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fully prepared to be at a physical 
disadvantage, Tamamo Cross decides to 
enter the Satsuki Sho, the first leg of 
the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The rival standing in her way is Gold 
City. Though outmatched in flashy looks, 
she issues a challenge, knowing a race is 
a whole different story.
